source_issue.title: It should be possible to open linked items in a new tab

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue aims to enhance the Volto editor by allowing linked items to be opened in a new browser tab. This functionality will improve user experience when managing links within the editor.

## What needs to be done
The main task is to refactor the existing links in the ObjectBrowserWidget component to use `<a>` tags, enabling them to open in new tabs. There is also a suggestion to indicate to users that these links will open in a new tab, though the details about how to implement this are still debated.

## Helpful background
There are several open pull requests (PRs) related to this issue and some confusion among contributors regarding the direction of changes. It’s noted that clear communication and following project guidelines will help streamline the process.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the ObjectBrowserWidget component linked in the issue description.
2. Discuss with team members about the best way to indicate links that open in new tabs.
3. If you are a new contributor, consider reviewing existing PRs for guidance.
4. Consider submitting a PR that conforms to the current coding standards and communicates clearly with others in the discussion.

Feel free to ask questions if anything is unclear!
```
